title: Three Family Members Killed at Al-Aqsa Martyrs Hospital, Deir al-Balah
detail: Three members of the same family were killed in a strike at Al-Aqsa Martyrs Hospital in Deir al-Balah, central Gaza. In the Muwasi area near Rafah, Israeli forces shot and killed a child the same day. The strikes came as Al Jazeera published an analysis describing an Israeli pattern of killing Gaza civil officials — including police officers targeted days earlier in Jabaliya — which humanitarian officials say is destabilizing the fragile post-ceasefire administration of the territory.

media.caption: Israeli strikes kill a dozen people in Gaza over two days, including three family members at Al-Aqsa Martyrs Hospital — July 15, 2026
